user.title: Configure INIM Prime
user.description:
Choose which integration mode(s) to use for this panel.

• Native — zones, partitions, arm/disarm, outputs, timers and roller shutters. Fast local polling.
• PrimeLAN — adds scenarios, GSM status, system faults and the event log.
• Both — all of the above (Native is used where it can, PrimeLAN for the rest).

Native only still covers the essentials; PrimeLAN requires the PrimeLAN card and its API key.

scan_intervals.name: Scan intervals
scan_intervals.description:
How often Home Assistant polls the panel (lower values = more traffic). Each entry shows the integration mode: Native (local protocol, fast) or PrimeLAN (Web API). Zones, partitions and outputs use the active integration mode (Native or PrimeLAN); GSM, faults, event log and scenarios are PrimeLAN only. With both integration modes the PrimeLAN-only pollers start slower (60s) to reduce traffic. See the README.
Note: if you've just added or removed Native, the defaults below have been adjusted accordingly.

data_description.zones: How often Home Assistant fetches zone status. Integration mode: Native/PrimeLAN.

data_description.gsm: How often Home Assistant fetches GSM status. PrimeLAN only.
data_description.system_faults: How often Home Assistant fetches system faults. PrimeLAN only.
data_description.panel_log_events: How often Home Assistant fetches new panel log events. PrimeLAN only.
data_description.outputs: How often Home Assistant reads the outputs status. Integration mode: Native/PrimeLAN.
data_description.scenarios: How often Home Assistant reads which scenario is active. PrimeLAN only.

shutters.name: Roller shutters
shutters.description: For each shutter (numbered by its Mod.dom module) give it an optional name (also used as the cover name, e.g. "Sala") and choose the panel command output that opens it and the one that closes it (e.g. "Apri tenda sala" / "Chiudi ... sala"). The Smart module runs the full travel from a single trigger and has no stop. You can also set 25/50/75% commands (partial-open outputs) to enable the position slider, which snaps to the nearest one. Leave empty to leave a shutter unmapped.

init.title: INIM Prime options
init.description: Edit whichever sections you like, then press “💾 Save and exit” to save everything. The X at the top closes without saving. To change the integration mode (Native / PrimeLAN) or the connection settings use Reconfigure (⋮ menu on the integration card).

alarm.title: Alarm panel
alarm.description: Pick a command to set its partitions: each entry shows its current configuration. “‹ Back to menu” returns to the main menu, where “💾 Save and exit” saves everything.

alarm_form.title: Alarm panel
alarm_form.description:
In the dropdown pick a panel scenario or “Custom partitions…”: in that case open the section right below and set each partition's mode and the outputs to activate. Leave the dropdown empty to not offer that command.

Note: if there are auto-bypassable zones use “Custom partitions…”: through a scenario, with one of those zones open, arming does not happen.

arm_home_partitions.name: ↳ Home: custom partitions and outputs
arm_home_partitions.description: Used only when “Custom partitions…” is selected above.

arm_away_partitions.name: ↳ Away: custom partitions and outputs
arm_away_partitions.description: Used only when “Custom partitions…” is selected above.

arm_night_partitions.name: ↳ Night: custom partitions and outputs
arm_night_partitions.description: Used only when “Custom partitions…” is selected above.

arm_vacation_partitions.name: ↳ Vacation: custom partitions and outputs
arm_vacation_partitions.description: Used only when “Custom partitions…” is selected above.

disarm_partitions.name: ↳ Disarmed: custom partitions and outputs
disarm_partitions.description: Used only when “Custom partitions…” is selected above.

alarm_form_primelan.title: Alarm panel
alarm_form_primelan.description:
In the dropdown pick the panel scenario to activate for each command. Leave the dropdown empty to not offer that command.

Note: if an auto-bypassable zone is open, arming through a scenario does not happen. With PrimeLAN mode alone there is no alternative: partitions require Native mode.

Number of log events fetched per scan when new logs are detected. Default is recommended.
The integration will automatically fetch more if needed.
data_description.show_hidden_outputs: Off shows only the outputs PrimeLAN publishes to the linked user. On also shows the panel internal/mainboard outputs.
data_description.hide_unused_partitions: Areas never named in the panel keep the default name. Enable to hide them and their entities.
data_description.realtime_push: Optional, requires PrimeLAN mode. The panel sends events (zones, arming, alarm…) to Home Assistant via a local webhook, so entities update instantly. Configure it in Prime/STUDIO → PrimeLAN settings → Web API → outbound HTTP API. After saving, the URL appears at the top of this screen.
data_description.alarm_pin_panel: Create a second alarm entity that requires a PIN to **disarm** (arming stays free). Handy for a wall tablet in a free-access room, leaving the original one without a PIN for your phone.
data_description.alarm_pin: Numeric code required to disarm from the PIN panel. It is a local card lock, not the panel's own code.
data_description.webhook_allow_remote: The webhook normally accepts LAN requests only. If Home Assistant is behind a reverse proxy and sees even local requests as «remote» (the webhook gets rejected), enable this. It is safe: the webhook only triggers a refresh and is guarded by the secret id in the URL.

shutters.title: Roller shutters
shutters.description: For each shutter choose the panel command output that opens it and the one that closes it (e.g. "Apri tenda sala" / "Chiudi tenda sala"). The Smart module runs the full travel from a single trigger: there is no stop, but while it is moving you can send another command and the shutter immediately takes the new one. You can also set 25/50/75% commands (partial-open outputs) to enable the position slider, which snaps to the nearest one. Leave empty to leave a shutter unmapped.

debug_read_terminals.description: Native protocol: raw status (10 bytes) of each terminal, with its label.

debug_watch_terminals.name: Debug: watch terminals
debug_watch_terminals.description: Native protocol: poll terminals for a while and return every raw status change.

debug_read_memory.name: Debug: read memory
debug_read_memory.description: Native protocol: read raw panel memory.

debug_raw_command.name: Debug: raw command
debug_raw_command.description: Native protocol: send a raw command. Can change the panel state: use with care.

debug_memory_diff.name: Debug: memory diff
debug_memory_diff.description: Native protocol: read a memory block and list the bytes changed since the previous call (snapshot=true only stores it).

snapshot.name: Snapshot only
snapshot.description: Only store the block, without comparing.

debug_write_memory.name: Debug: write memory
debug_write_memory.description: Native protocol: write raw bytes to panel memory, like Prime/STUDIO does. Changes the panel: use with care.

session.name: Programming session
session.description: Wrap the write in the begin/end commands Prime/STUDIO sends.

debug_probe_commands.name: Debug: probe commands
debug_probe_commands.description: Native protocol: send plain commands (operation + data, no PIN) and return the answers. Unknown commands may change the panel: use with care.
